claim: tldr explain /tmp/repos/ripgrep/crates/globset/src/glob.rs <function> reports complexity.cognitive: null even though tldr cognitive on the same file reports cog=19 for the same function. The explain aggregator isn't propagating the cognitive metric.

verdict_detail.artifact_aspect: The audit's 'null' claim was a serde-skipped-Option appearance under jq probes that coalesce missing keys to null. The complexity.cognitive field never existed in ComplexityInfo at all — for ANY language (verified python+rust pre-fix both lacked the key).
verdict_detail.real_aspect: The underlying user-facing gap IS real: tldr explain's complexity block reports cyclomatic/num_blocks/num_edges/has_loops while tldr cognitive computes a SonarSource cognitive score from the same AST — these two related commands disagree on the same function's complexity surface. Closing this gap is the user-facing fix the audit intended.

fix.wiring_site: crates/tldr-cli/src/commands/remaining/explain.rs around line 2577 (right after the get_cfg_context num_blocks alignment)
fix.implementation: Calls tldr_core::metrics::analyze_cognitive with function_filter=Some(self.function) and joins by (line, name) preference falling back to plain name. Failure modes (parse error, unsupported language, function not found) leave the field None — the additive wiring never breaks consumers.
fix.text_formatter: format_explain_text also prints `  Cognitive: <n>` line when populated, mirroring the JSON additive surface.

list: rust_explain_complexity_cognitive_not_null — asserts explain.complexity.cognitive is a non-null u64 > 0 for ripgrep/globset/glob.rs::parse
rust_explain_cognitive_matches_standalone — asserts explain.complexity.cognitive == standalone `tldr cognitive` for the same function
python_explain_cognitive_still_works (non-regression) — pins the same agreement for flask app.py::make_response, verifying the fix is language-agnostic
